name: route_handler
description: Content-aware rule routing dispatcher that matches message payloads against configurable criteria.

outputs.name: output_channels
outputs.label: Route Target Channels
outputs.description: Available destination channels targeted by routing rules.

default_action.label: Default Action
default_action.description: Action taken when no rules match.

rules.label: Routing Rules
rules.description: Sequential rules evaluated against message payload and metadata.

type.label: Condition Engine
type.description: Engine used to evaluate match criteria: 'expression' (boolean logic & metadata comparisons), 'pattern' (substring text search), or 'lua' (arbitrary script code).

pattern.label: Match Pattern
pattern.description: Substring pattern to search for inside raw message payload.
pattern.ui:help: Matches if the message payload contains this exact substring.

expression.label: Boolean Expression
expression.description: Composite expression with boolean operators, predicates, and metadata comparisons.
expression.ui:help:
Supported syntax:
• contains("txt" [, count]), prefix("hdr"), exact("full")
• metadata.<field> [==, !=, <, <=, >, >=] <value>
• port == <num> or port(<num>), protocol == <id>
• Operators: and / &&, or / ||, not / !, parentheses ( )

functions.name: contains
functions.doc: Matches if payload contains substring (optionally matching count times).

functions.name: prefix
functions.doc: Matches if payload begins with prefix text.

functions.name: exact
functions.doc: Matches if payload equals exact text.

scopes.name: metadata
scopes.doc: Protocol metadata attributes reflected from C++

script.label: Lua Script
script.description: Custom Lua script block evaluated against incoming message.
script.ui:help:
Provide a script returning function(msg) -> bool (or function route(msg)).
• msg.payload: raw ASCII string of payload
• msg.protocol: numeric protocol ID
• msg.port: source UDP port
• msg.meta.<field>: parsed metadata fields from catalog
